    "NCD":          "#2E6FA8",   # authoritative blue
    "Injury":       "#6BAF6E",   # muted green
}

# ── Data ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# global_category_totals
glob = {
    1990: {"Communicable": 1128.4, "NCD": 768.2,  "Injury": 253.7},
    2024: {"Communicable": 612.5,  "NCD": 1487.3, "Injury": 308.6},
}

# daly_by_income_group
income_groups = ["Low income", "Lower-middle income", "Upper-middle income", "High income"]
ig_data = {
    1990: {
        "Low income":          {"Communicable": 71.2, "NCD": 19.8, "Injury": 9.0},
        "Lower-middle income": {"Communicable": 52.4, "NCD": 36.1, "Injury": 11.5},
        "Upper-middle income": {"Communicable": 28.7, "NCD": 57.3, "Injury": 14.0},
        "High income":         {"Communicable":  8.3, "NCD": 81.6, "Injury": 10.1},
    },
    2024: {
        "Low income":          {"Communicable": 52.8, "NCD": 37.4, "Injury": 9.8},
        "Lower-middle income": {"Communicable": 27.1, "NCD": 60.5, "Injury": 12.4},
        "Upper-middle income": {"Communicable": 11.3, "NCD": 77.2, "Injury": 11.5},
        "High income":         {"Communicable":  4.1, "NCD": 87.8, "Injury":  8.1},
    },
}

# top10 causes
top10_raw = [
    (1990, 1,  "Lower respiratory infections", 178.5, "Communicable"),
    (1990, 2,  "Diarrheal diseases",           155.2, "Communicable"),
    (1990, 3,  "Neonatal preterm birth",        103.8, "Communicable"),
    (1990, 4,  "Ischemic heart disease",         98.6, "NCD"),
    (1990, 5,  "Stroke",                         82.4, "NCD"),
    (1990, 6,  "Malaria",                         78.1, "Communicable"),
    (1990, 7,  "Tuberculosis",                    72.3, "Communicable"),
    (1990, 8,  "Measles",                         65.9, "Communicable"),
    (1990, 9,  "COPD",                            57.2, "NCD"),
    (1990, 10, "Road injuries",                   52.7, "Injury"),
    (2024, 1,  "Ischemic heart disease",         192.3, "NCD"),
    (2024, 2,  "Stroke",                         147.8, "NCD"),
    (2024, 3,  "Diabetes mellitus",              118.4, "NCD"),
    (2024, 4,  "COPD",                           105.1, "NCD"),
    (2024, 5,  "Neonatal preterm birth",          82.6, "Communicable"),
    (2024, 6,  "Lower respiratory infections",    78.3, "Communicable"),
    (2024, 7,  "Low back pain",                   74.9, "NCD"),
    (2024, 8,  "Depressive disorders",            68.5, "NCD"),
    (2024, 9,  "Road injuries",                   63.2, "Injury"),
    (2024, 10, "Lung cancer",                     58.7, "NCD"),
]

causes_1990 = {r[2]: r[1] for r in top10_raw if r[0] == 1990}
causes_2024 = {r[2]: r[1] for r in top10_raw if r[0] == 2024}
causes_1990_info = {r[2]: (r[1], r[3], r[4]) for r in top10_raw if r[0] == 1990}
causes_2024_info = {r[2]: (r[1], r[3], r[4]) for r in top10_raw if r[0] == 2024}

# All unique causes across both years (union), sorted by 2024 rank then 1990
all_causes_set = set(causes_1990) | set(causes_2024)

# Build slope-chart list: only causes appearing in BOTH years (rank changes)
shared = sorted(
    [(c, causes_1990[c], causes_2024[c]) for c in all_causes_set
     if c in causes_1990 and c in causes_2024],
    key=lambda x: x[2]  # sort by 2024 rank

# Also track unique-to-1990 and unique-to-2024
only_1990 = sorted([(c, causes_1990[c]) for c in all_causes_set if c not in causes_2024], key=lambda x: x[1])
only_2024 = sorted([(c, causes_2024[c]) for c in all_causes_set if c not in causes_1990], key=lambda x: x[1])

    ax.set_facecolor("#F8F7F4")

# Panel A & B — Global donut pies
# ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
def draw_donut(ax, year_data, year, total):
    cats = ["Communicable", "NCD", "Injury"]
    vals = [year_data[c] for c in cats]
    colors = [CAT_COLORS[c] for c in cats]
    wedges, _ = ax.pie(
        vals, colors=colors,
        startangle=90,
        wedgeprops=dict(width=0.52, edgecolor="#F8F7F4", linewidth=2),
    )
    ax.set_facecolor("#F8F7F4")
    # Center text
    ax.text(0, 0.06, str(year), ha='center', va='center',
            fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', color=LABEL_COLOR, fontfamily='DejaVu Sans')
    ax.text(0, -0.18, f"{total:,.0f}M\nDALYs", ha='center', va='center',
            fontsize=8.5, color="#555555", fontfamily='DejaVu Sans', linespacing=1.4)

    # Percentage labels on wedge
    cumulative = 0
    for i, (val, cat) in enumerate(zip(vals, cats)):
        pct = val / sum(vals) * 100
        mid_angle = 90 - (cumulative + pct / 2) * 3.6
        r = 0.82
        x = r * np.cos(np.radians(mid_angle))
        y = r * np.sin(np.radians(mid_angle))
        ax.text(x, y, f"{pct:.0f}%", ha='center', va='center',
                fontsize=8, color='white', fontweight='bold')
        cumulative += pct

for ax, yr in [(ax_pie1, 1990), (ax_pie2, 2024)]:
    total = sum(glob[yr].values())
    draw_donut(ax, glob[yr], yr, total)
    ax.set_title(f"Global DALY Composition", fontsize=9.5, color=LABEL_COLOR, pad=6,
                 fontfamily='DejaVu Sans', fontweight='bold')

# Shared legend for pies
legend_patches = [
    mpatches.Patch(color=CAT_COLORS[c], label=c) for c in ["Communicable", "NCD", "Injury"]
]
ax_pie1.legend(
    handles=legend_patches, loc='lower center', bbox_to_anchor=(0.5, -0.08),
    frameon=False, fontsize=8.5, ncol=1,
    labelcolor=LABEL_COLOR,
)

# Panel C — Slope / Bump chart: top-10 rank changes
# ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
style_ax(ax_slope)

# We'll plot all causes that appeared in top-10 in either year
# y-axis = rank (1 at top, 12 at bottom for causes that dropped out)

RANK_OUT = 11.5   # visual rank for "not in top 10"

def get_rank(cause, year):
    d = causes_1990 if year == 1990 else causes_2024
    return d.get(cause, RANK_OUT)

def get_cat(cause):
    if cause in causes_1990_info:
        return causes_1990_info[cause][2]
    if cause in causes_2024_info:
        return causes_2024_info[cause][2]
    return "NCD"

all_causes = sorted(all_causes_set)
X_LEFT, X_RIGHT = 0, 1

for cause in all_causes:
    r90  = get_rank(cause, 1990)
    r24  = get_rank(cause, 2024)
    cat  = get_cat(cause)
    col  = CAT_COLORS[cat]
    delta = r90 - r24  # positive = improved rank

    lw = 2.2 if abs(delta) >= 3 else 1.2
    alpha = 1.0 if abs(delta) >= 3 else 0.55

    ax_slope.plot(
        [X_LEFT, X_RIGHT], [r90, r24],
        color=col, linewidth=lw, alpha=alpha,
        solid_capstyle='round',
    )
    # Dots
    dot_size = 70 if abs(delta) >= 3 else 40
    ax_slope.scatter([X_LEFT], [r90], color=col, s=dot_size, zorder=5, alpha=alpha)
    ax_slope.scatter([X_RIGHT], [r24], color=col, s=dot_size, zorder=5, alpha=alpha)

# Labels left side (1990)
for cause in all_causes:
    r = get_rank(cause, 1990)
    cat = get_cat(cause)
    col = CAT_COLORS[cat]
    delta = get_rank(cause, 1990) - get_rank(cause, 2024)
    fw = 'bold' if abs(delta) >= 3 else 'normal'
    label = cause if r <= 10 else f"({cause})"
    ax_slope.text(X_LEFT - 0.03, r, label, ha='right', va='center',
                  fontsize=7.5, color=col, fontweight=fw)

# Labels right side (2024)
for cause in all_causes:
    r = get_rank(cause, 2024)
    cat = get_cat(cause)
    col = CAT_COLORS[cat]
    delta = get_rank(cause, 1990) - get_rank(cause, 2024)
    fw = 'bold' if abs(delta) >= 3 else 'normal'
    label = cause if r <= 10 else f"({cause})"
    ax_slope.text(X_RIGHT + 0.03, r, label, ha='left', va='center',
                  fontsize=7.5, color=col, fontweight=fw)

ax_slope.set_xlim(-0.45, 1.45)
ax_slope.set_ylim(12.5, 0.3)
ax_slope.set_xticks([X_LEFT, X_RIGHT])
ax_slope.set_xticklabels(["1990", "2024"], fontsize=12, fontweight='bold', color=LABEL_COLOR)
ax_slope.set_yticks(range(1, 11))
ax_slope.yaxis.set_visible(False)
ax_slope.xaxis.tick_top()
ax_slope.xaxis.set_label_position('top')
ax_slope.tick_params(axis='x', which='both', length=0, pad=6)
for spine in ax_slope.spines.values():
    spine.set_visible(False)

# Rank label on y-axis positions
for rank in range(1, 11):
    ax_slope.text(X_LEFT - 0.46, rank, f"#{rank}", ha='left', va='center',
                  fontsize=7, color="#999999")
    ax_slope.text(X_RIGHT + 0.44, rank, f"#{rank}", ha='right', va='center',
                  fontsize=7, color="#999999")

ax_slope.set_title("Top-10 DALY Causes: Rank Shifts 1990 → 2024",
                   fontsize=10.5, fontweight='bold', color=LABEL_COLOR, pad=14,
                   fontfamily='DejaVu Sans')

# Arrow annotation for biggest movers
ax_slope.annotate("", xy=(X_RIGHT, 1), xytext=(X_LEFT, 4),
                  arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="-|>", color=CAT_COLORS["NCD"],
                                  lw=1.5, mutation_scale=10))
ax_slope.annotate("", xy=(X_RIGHT, 6), xytext=(X_LEFT, 1),
                  arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="-|>", color=CAT_COLORS["Communicable"],
                                  lw=1.5, mutation_scale=10))

ig_short = {

    "Lower-middle income": "Lower-\nmiddle",
    "Upper-middle income": "Upper-\nmiddle",

y_positions = []
y_labels    = []
bar_height  = 0.32
gap_between = 0.18   # gap between 1990 and 2024 bar of same group

    # 1990 bar
    y90 = y
    comm90 = ig_data[1990][ig]["Communicable"]
    ncd90  = ig_data[1990][ig]["NCD"]
    inj90  = ig_data[1990][ig]["Injury"]
    ax_bar.barh(y90, comm90, height=bar_height, color=CAT_COLORS["Communicable"], left=0, alpha=0.9)
    ax_bar.barh(y90, ncd90,  height=bar_height, color=CAT_COLORS["NCD"],          left=comm90, alpha=0.9)
    ax_bar.barh(y90, inj90,  height=bar_height, color=CAT_COLORS["Injury"],        left=comm90+ncd90, alpha=0.9)
    ax_bar.text(-1.5, y90, "1990", ha='right', va='center', fontsize=7, color="#888888", style='italic')

    # 2024 bar

    ax_bar.barh(y24, comm24, height=bar_height, color=CAT_COLORS["Communicable"], left=0, alpha=0.9)
    ax_bar.barh(y24, ncd24,  height=bar_height, color=CAT_COLORS["NCD"],          left=comm24, alpha=0.9)
    ax_bar.barh(y24, inj24,  height=bar_height, color=CAT_COLORS["Injury"],        left=comm24+ncd24, alpha=0.9)
    ax_bar.text(-1.5, y24, "2024", ha='right', va='center', fontsize=7, color="#444444", fontweight='bold')

    # Group label
    mid_y = (y90 + y24) / 2
    y_positions.append(mid_y)

    y += bar_height * 2 + gap_between + group_gap

ax_bar.set_yticks(y_positions)
ax_bar.set_yticklabels(y_labels, fontsize=8.5, color=LABEL_COLOR, fontfamily='DejaVu Sans')
ax_bar.set_xlabel("Share of Total DALYs (%)", fontsize=9, color=LABEL_COLOR, labelpad=6)
ax_bar.set_xlim(0, 105)
ax_bar.set_ylim(-0.2, y - group_gap + 0.2)
ax_bar.xaxis.set_major_formatter(plt.FuncFormatter(lambda x, _: f"{int(x)}%"))
ax_bar.tick_params(axis='x', labelsize=8, colors=LABEL_COLOR)
ax_bar.tick_params(axis='y', length=0)
for spine in ['top', 'right', 'left']:
    ax_bar.spines[spine].set_visible(False)
ax_bar.spines['bottom'].set_edgecolor(GRID_COLOR)
ax_bar.xaxis.grid(True, color=GRID_COLOR, linestyle='--', linewidth=0.6, alpha=0.7)
ax_bar.set_axisbelow(True)

ax_bar.set_title("Disease Burden by Income Group\n& Year", fontsize=10.5,
                 fontweight='bold', color=LABEL_COLOR, pad=10, fontfamily='DejaVu Sans')

# In-bar percent labels for communicable (if wide enough)
y = 0
for ig in income_groups:
    for yr, ypos in [(1990, y), (2024, y + bar_height + gap_between)]:
        comm = ig_data[yr][ig]["Communicable"]
        if comm > 12:
            ax_bar.text(comm / 2, ypos, f"{comm:.0f}%", ha='center', va='center',
                        fontsize=6.5, color='white', fontweight='bold')
        ncd = ig_data[yr][ig]["NCD"]
        if ncd > 12:
            ax_bar.text(comm + ncd / 2, ypos, f"{ncd:.0f}%", ha='center', va='center',
                        fontsize=6.5, color='white', fontweight='bold')
    y += bar_height * 2 + gap_between + group_gap

# Shared legend for bar
legend_patches2 = [
    mpatches.Patch(color=CAT_COLORS[c], label=c) for c in ["Communicable", "NCD", "Injury"]
]
ax_bar.legend(
    handles=legend_patches2, loc='lower right', fontsize=8,
    frameon=True, facecolor="#F8F7F4", edgecolor=GRID_COLOR,
    labelcolor=LABEL_COLOR,
)

# Panel labels
for ax, lbl in [(ax_pie1, "A"), (ax_pie2, "B"), (ax_slope, "C"), (ax_bar, "D")]:
    ax.annotate(lbl, xy=(0.02, 0.97), xycoords='axes fraction',
                fontsize=11, fontweight='bold', color=LABEL_COLOR, va='top')

plt.close()
print("Saved /app/output/result.png")
